idea-plugin.name: Ko Typo Converter - Korean Layout Typo Fixer
idea-plugin.description:
Fixes Korean that was typed while the keyboard was still in English mode (for example dkssud becomes 안녕), right inside comments, strings and markup text.

  • Converts when you press Space or Enter, when you pause typing (0.5 s), and once more on save.
  • Only touches comments, strings, text between tags and plain parentheses. Code is never changed.
  • Words that only look like Korean are left alone: 10,748 common English words (air, city, test, ...) are never converted.
  • Reverse direction: a keyword typed in Korean mode in code (채ㅜ내ㅣㄷ) goes back to console, but only when it matches a known term or a name already used in the file.
  • Supports 2-beolsik (standard) and 3-beolsik 390 / final layouts.
  • Close the completion popup first, then convert. Ctrl+Z undoes a conversion and it will not come back.
  • Manual: select text and press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K, or right-click > 한영 타자 변환기.

Same engine as the VS Code extension of the same name; the Java port is checked against the JavaScript engine case by case. Settings: Settings > Tools > 한영 타자 변환기.

한/영 전환을 깜빡하고 영문 상태로 친 한글(dkssud)을 주석·문자열·태그 안에서 바로 한글(안녕)로 고쳐 줍니다. 스페이스·엔터를 칠 때, 잠깐 멈췄을 때, 저장할 때 바뀌고, 코드 자리는 건드리지 않습니다. 흔한 영어 단어 10,748개는 그대로 두고, 2벌식과 세벌식 390·최종을 지원합니다.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — First JetBrains release. Same rules as the VS Code extension 0.1.1: 2-beolsik and 3-beolsik (390, final), reverse conversion in code, conversion on Space/Enter/pause/save, selection conversion (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K) and a "fix whole document" action.
